infeasibility.ruling: ⛔ NO re-allocation at a fixed budget rescues a high-PR well: at ε = 0.10 a PR = 13.63 well needs ~6.5 million codewords. A partial fix is NOT a fix and must not be reported as one.

fit.reading: slope 1 + offset 1 would be the law exactly; slope < 1 means the measured distortion is FLATTER in M than M^(-2/PR) predicts, i.e. extra codewords buy LESS than the law promises.
